# How many units should you own?

> Free rental fleet size optimizer for tent, equipment, kayak, tool and party rental businesses. Enter your seasons, rental lengths, price and what a unit costs to own; it finds the number of units that maximises yearly profit using the Erlang loss formula and a day-by-day simulation.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
